csv_diagnosis.scope: Raw/sample Present-row and Dropped-flag counts only; no rows sorted, removed or deduplicated; no Present/display interval or latency percentiles

renderer_source_imports.scope: renderer-device COM aliases only; cache capacity excludes the active reader; miss-before-eviction can transiently retain capacity+1 aliases; all includes startup/warmup/cleanup; sampled follows renderer attempts; wall time includes preemption; counts do not prove physical residency

gpu_stages.scope: Elapsed intervals on one renderer immediate context, including any gaps or dependencies between markers; not GPU busy time, cross-context critical path or scanout.
gpu_stages.interpretation: Native-output and editor intervals include target acquisition, drawing and Present when attempted. A dominant interval locates elapsed time, not its internal cause. QPC values are identity/completion bounds, never subtracted from GPU ticks.

live_etw_observation_recomputed.scope: Successful independent live API query only; later event delivery/shutdown and PresentMon analysis loss remain unverified

collector_loss_warnings_recomputed.scope: collector warning observations only; absence does not prove zero ETW or analysis loss

limits: Original capture flags and raw CSV order remain unchanged
Unordered row counts do not repair ordering or scene-geometry validation
No Present/display intervals, software-latency percentiles or qualification pass
Live loss counters are a snapshot, not final capture or analysis zero loss
Stage intervals are elapsed bounds, not GPU busy time or a cross-context critical path
